ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; high-intensity white pixels comprise approximately 70-75% of the visible ventral area, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the margins and central notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions cover the interior of both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and extends into the central peduncle area. Notable discrete black focal spots are located at the distal tips of both lobes. A distinct, curved black band is visible on the inner-lower quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; central angle is sharp, approximately 50-60 degrees, with the apex positioned at the convergence of the lobe inner margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jaggedness with varying pixel-amplitude peaks, particularly pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit an upward-lateral sweep with a generally convex trailing edge profile that terminates in pointed, slightly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular dark clusters are detected at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized scarring or previous barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple fine, dark linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible; several cross the white surface of the left lobe diagonally, and others are clustered near the central-right margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks/scratches across the white ventral surface and focal scarring on the lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive, thick curved black line/arc located on the lower-medial portion of the right lobe's white surface.
